title: MCP Registry cannot verify a Cargo crate that hides mcp-name in an HTML comment
symptoms: Publishing a crates.io server fails ownership verification
The same hidden mcp-name comment works for a PyPI or NuGet package
cause: For Cargo the registry looks for the mcp-name token in the README as rendered by crates.io, and crates.io strips HTML comments during rendering, so a hidden comment never reaches the validator.
fix: Put the mcp-name line in the README as visible text, for example a bullet in a links section.
affected: Official MCP Registry, crates.io packages, as of 2026-10
